description: Header file defining FileSystemMonitor class for monitoring file system changes across platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows). It includes platform-specific implementations for file system event watching, callback registration, and notification handling.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Main class for monitoring file system changes, platform-specific implementations included.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to be notified of file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Internal class managing callbacks for a specific file or directory.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Platform-specific class handling directory change notifications (Windows).

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class managing event dispatching for Windows platform.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory to monitor changes.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from a specific file or directory.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized and active.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Process
methods.description: Processes file system events and notifies registered callbacks (Windows).
